title.full: Using MediSave for family hospital bills

summary.text: You can use your MediSave for an approved dependant if they do not have enough in their own account.

details.heading: Withdrawal limits apply
details.body: The amount your dependant can use is subject to MediSave withdrawal limits for each hospitalisation episode. Any remaining hospital bill after using the limit must be paid in cash.

steps.name: Check they qualify
steps.text: They must be your spouse, child, parent, grandparent or sibling. Grandparents and siblings must be Singapore Citizens or Permanent Residents.

items: Approved dependants are your spouse, children, parents, grandparents and siblings.
Grandparents and siblings must be Singapore Citizens or Permanent Residents.

steps.name: Sign the authorisation form
steps.text: At the hospital where your family member is receiving treatment, sign the Medical Claims Authorisation Form. The hospital will submit the claim, and payment will go directly to the hospital.

items: Sign the Medical Claims Authorisation Form at the hospital where they are receiving treatment.
The hospital submits the claim, and payment from your MediSave goes directly to the hospital.

about.text: The hospital’s Business Office can give you more information.

sources.page_title: Can I use my MediSave to pay for my family member’s hospitalisation expenses?

quotes.text: If your approved dependants do not have sufficient MediSave for their hospitalisation expenses, you may consider using your MediSave to pay for them.

Approved dependants refer to a member’s spouse, children, parents, grandparents and siblings. They can be of any nationality except for grandparents and siblings who must be Singapore Citizens or Permanent Residents.

Should you wish to use your MediSave for your approved dependants’ hospitalisation expenses, you may approach the hospital where they are receiving treatment at to sign the Medical Claims Authorisation Form (MCAF).
For more information, please speak to the staff at the hospital's Business Office.

It is important to note that while your approved dependants can tap on your MediSave, the amount they can use is still subject to the MediSave withdrawal limits, which is applied on a per hospitalisation episode basis. If they still have outstanding hospitalisation expenses after using up to the MediSave withdrawal limit, they would have to pay the remainder in cash.
